name: Kamonegi-go ga Mahou Ken de Ippai ni Naru
original_name: カモネギ号が魔法剣でいっぱいになる
source:
You woke up, in the world of magic swords.
You don't know anything about the catastrophe five years ago in This world.
You'll be working as a radio operator, and you'll be attacked by a black magic sword.
Who is the "Messenger", who knows the terrible power of a black magic sword, the identity of a magic sword, and everything?
Your choices determine the fate of this world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270230/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你一觉醒来，已身处魔剑世界。
你对这个世界五年前的浩劫一无所知。
你将担任无线电操作员，你将受到黑魔法剑的攻击。
谁是“使者”，谁知道黑魔剑的可怕力量，魔剑的身份，以及一切？
你的选择决定了这个世界的命运。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270230/]Steam[/url]]
